content: {"episode_id":"ep-05083","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the CO-97 denial for cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) based on the documented clinical indication. The patient has recurrent dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction. The cardiac event monitor was ordered to evaluate potential arrhythmic causes of these symptoms and assess any correlation between cardiac rhythm disturbances and the patient's neurological history."}
